t: AI Human Flourishing: Flourishing Index — Simple
name: AI Human Flourishing: Flourishing Index — Simple
title: AI Human Flourishing: Flourishing Index — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] An index that measures what GDP misses: health, learning, agency, connection, and security, each with visible components. The index is computed per community from surveys and administrative data, and every component stays inspectable.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Weighted index from components (0.35x0.8 + 0.25x0.7 + 0.25x0.65 + 0.15x0.6) = 0.7075 index. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Human Flourishing (Chapter)
real_world_basis: Multidimensional wellbeing indices are published by the UN, OECD, and many governments.
signature_version: Signature version: the flourishing Balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (material vs non-material) scored per community, with the 'universal flourishing' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: choose indicators with the community, publish weights, and never revise history silently.
math_note: Weighted index from components (0.35x0.8 + 0.25x0.7 + 0.25x0.65 + 0.15x0.6): 0.7075 index [verified]; Change rate: 0.71 to 0.76 over 4 years: 0.0125 index/yr [verified]
safety: Dignity safety: the index describes communities for policy; it must never be used to rank human worth.
how_it_works: Indicators normalize against reference levels, weight by community panel, and aggregate; the dashboard shows components beside the total. The demo recomputes a weighted index and its year-on-year change rate.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

t: AI Human Flourishing: Capability Tracker — Simple
name: AI Human Flourishing: Capability Tracker — Simple
title: AI Human Flourishing: Capability Tracker — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A tracker for human capabilities — what people are actually able to do and be: literacy, mobility, digital access, civic participation. It measures functionings, not just resources, per the capabilities approach.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.25 = 10 samples. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Human Flourishing (Chapter)
real_world_basis: The capabilities approach (Sen/Nussbaum) underpins the UN Human Development Index.
signature_version: Signature version: the flourishing Totality assessor — capabilities held vs capabilities realized as a computed ratio, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: define capabilities with the people measured, validate surveys independently, then track.
math_note: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.25: 10 samples [verified]; Diversity bits across 32 capability profiles: 5.0 bits [verified]

math_check.label: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.25

safety: Dignity safety: capability data describes populations for policy; it must never be used to rank individuals.
how_it_works: Survey and administrative data feed per-capability indicators; the tracker reports conversion factors (what turns resources into real freedoms). The demo recomputes the audit sample for survey validation.

title: AI Human Flourishing: Opportunity Mapper — Simple
description:

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Service circle area, r = 2.5 km = 19.63 km2. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

signature_version: Signature version: the flourishing First/Last assessor — baseline access (first) and current (last) anchored per district, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: get the population grid right first, map services honestly, then rank gaps by people affected.
math_note: Service circle area, r = 2.5 km: 19.63 km2 [verified]; Pipeline latency over 120 km fiber: 0.60 ms [verified]
